summary: recharts peer dependency added for the new Chart primitives
New ./tokens.css export; consumer Tailwind builds need the tokens.css import and an @source for the DS dist

steps.note: Add @import "@studio-manfred/manfred-design-system/tokens.css"; to your Tailwind v4 input CSS, alongside @import "tailwindcss";. Without it, shadcn-shape utilities the DS components rely on (bg-muted, text-muted-foreground, bg-accent, bg-card, bg-popover, bg-destructive, border-border, ring-ring, etc.) compile to nothing in your build.

Also add @source "<relative path to>/node_modules/@studio-manfred/manfred-design-system/dist"; to the same CSS file. Without it, responsive and arbitrary classes used inside DS components (e.g. AppHeader's md:flex) lose the cascade to your own Tailwind utilities and break in production builds.
The DatePicker wrapper's public API is unchanged. Code that imports react-day-picker directly must follow its v10 upgrade guide (https://daypicker.dev/upgrading).
